texts:
Week 4 broke four backfields, so the waiver wire is stocked with running backs again.

The first claim is Kyle Monangai, who took 30 carries after Chicago benched Swift. Claim him, 10 to 20 percent of FAAB. Let's look into it.
#DaBears

1. Kyle Monangai, CHI RB: 30 carries for 146 and 2 TDs vs NYJ. D'Andre Swift fumbled in the third and never came back.

The thumb imaging was clean, and he is day to day and fine for GB. Claim him, 10 to 20 percent.
#DaBears #GoPackGo

D'Andre Swift, CHI RB: 15 for 58 before the fumble, then the bench.

RB13 rest of season for me. Hold him; a second straight game on the bench with Monangai healthy is what changes it.
#DaBears

2. Dohnte Meyers, CIN WR: 7 catches for 82 after Ja'Marr Chase left with a concussion.

Tee Higgins' adductor usually costs two to three weeks, and Iosivas is on IR. Burrow threw 54 times. Claim him, 8 to 15 percent.
#WhoDey #PhinsUp

3. Emanuel Wilson, SEA RB: 21 carries for 81, 3 catches for 39 and 2 TDs vs LAC.

Joe Mixon signed to the practice squad, and Charbonnet needs another week or two. Claim him, 10 to 15 percent.
#Seahawks #FTTB

4. Will Shipley, PHI RB: 28 of 61 snaps vs LAR, the only healthy back at the end.

Tank Bigsby goes to IR for about six weeks, so Shipley is Barkley's only backup. Claim him, 3 to 6 percent.
#FlyEaglesFly #DUUUVAL

Saquon Barkley, PHI RB: 4 snaps before the hamstring. The tests were not believed to show anything serious.

Monitor Wednesday's practice report before London; Shipley is the lead back @JAX if Barkley sits.
#FlyEaglesFly

5. Keaton Mitchell, LAC RB: 15 touches @SEA to Omarion Hampton's 9, a week after 8 carries for 52.

The touches have gone his way two weeks running. Claim him, 4 to 8 percent.
#BoltUp #BroncosCountry

6. Keon Coleman, BUF WR: routes on 31 of 40 dropbacks vs NE and 6 for 116 and a TD after DJ Moore left. He is on 4 percent of rosters.

Moore is day to day with the shoulder. Claim him, 3 to 6 percent.
#BillsMafia #RamsHouse

7. Tyler Allgeier, ARI RB: 8 for 42 and a TD @NYG, and 3 of 5 goal-line snaps the week before.

Jeremiyah Love tweaked his other ankle and says his workload is managed. Claim him, 3 to 6 percent.
#BirdGang #OnePride

8. KC Concepcion Jr., CLE WR: 92 percent of the snaps and a team-high 8 targets vs PIT, 5 for 64.

WR41 rest of season for me. Claim him, 2 to 5 percent.
#DawgPound #JetUp

9. Darius Cooper, PHI WR: 55 of 61 snaps, a team-high 7 targets and 2 TDs vs LAR.

DeVonta Smith is out two to three games. Add him, 1 to 3 percent.
#FlyEaglesFly

10. Romeo Doubs, NE WR: 2 TDs @BUF with A.J. Brown on IR and Mack Hollins out with the calf.

WR50 rest of season for me. Add him, 1 to 3 percent, and play him vs LV only if Hollins sits.
#NEPats #RaiderNation

Streamers.

Kirk Cousins, LV QB: 365 yards and 2 TDs vs KC, multiple TD passes three straight weeks. Stream him @NE, 2 to 4 percent.

Brenton Strange, JAX TE: 7 for 95 on a team-high 8 targets. Stream him vs PHI, 1 to 3 percent.
#RaiderNation #DUUUVAL

Stashes.

Zach Charbonnet, SEA RB: practice window open since Oct 1. He takes over from Wilson. Stash him, 3 to 6 percent.

Tyreek Hill, free agent WR: could sign within days, with a November target. Stash him, 2 to 5 percent.
#Seahawks #ChiefsKingdom

More stashes.

Tyler Huntley, BAL QB: Lamar Jackson's ankle had no diagnosis after the MRI. Superflex only, stash him, 3 to 6 percent.

RJ Harvey, DEN RB: 10 catches for 68 @SF, career highs. Stash him, 1 to 3 percent.
#RavensFlock #BroncosCountry

Cut bait.

Tank Bigsby, PHI RB: core muscle surgery, IR for about six weeks. Drop him.

Marcus Mariota, WAS QB: re-sprained MCL, multiple weeks, and Jayden Daniels is practicing in full. Drop him.
#FlyEaglesFly #RaiseHail

More cuts.

Tyquan Thornton, KC WR: dislocated ankle, out indefinitely. Drop him unless you have an open IR spot.

Xavier Hutchinson, HOU WR: Nico Collins came back to 69 percent of the snaps and 2 TDs. Drop him.
#ChiefsKingdom #HTownMade

Pass on Austin Ekeler, WAS RB: 17 snaps, 27 percent, and 5 touches in his first game, all because Rachaad White's shoulder kept him out.

Leave Ekeler on waivers, and drop him if you already added him.
#RaiseHail

Monday night: Atlanta ran for five TDs in a 45-24 win at NO. Brian Robinson Jr. took three from close range behind Bijan's 145 yards.

Stash Robinson Jr. in 14-team leagues only, 0 to 1 percent.
#DirtyBirds #Saints

Juwan Johnson, NO TE: 6 for 59 with Noah Fant inactive.

TE11 rest of season for me. Hold him.

Alvin Kamara, NO RB: two short TDs. Hold him as a flex while Etienne is out.
#Saints

Every add, stash and drop with the full FAAB read is on the site. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the Menu tomorrow and the rest of the week's calls, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/market.html?week=5
